title: State Commission
description: Definition of State Commission under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission established under sub-section (1) of section 42
content.plain_language: a government body in a state that helps resolve consumer disputes
examples: The Maharashtra State Commission heard a case against a defective product manufacturer
A consumer filed a complaint with the State Commission of Delhi
non_examples: A private company that resolves disputes between customers and sellers
A local court that only handles criminal cases

user_queries: What is the State Commission for consumer protection
How to file a complaint with the State Commission
What does the State Commission do
